mappings.source_provenance: The mapping declares the source system, extract, and source identifiers it translates as governed provenance.
mappings.mapping_posture: Mapping rules translate source codes and values into candidate governed forms without asserting their institutional validity.
mappings.uncertainty_posture: Ambiguous mappings are recorded as uncertain and quarantined rather than forced into false certainty.
mappings.identity_resolution_dependency: A mapped record becomes a resolved identity only through governed identity resolution, which the mapping does not itself perform.

identity.resolution_posture: A source record is resolved to a governed identity only on governed evidence; resolution is never presumed from a mapping.
identity.uncertainty_posture: Duplicate candidates and ambiguous correspondences are recorded as uncertain.
identity.unresolved_posture: An unresolved identity is quarantined and confers no governed standing.
